theorems.name: Submission.ts_piece_weighted_blowup_ae
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (a : RectifiablePair n ℓ) (C : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (F : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → Ambient n ℓ), 0 < n → (IsCompact C ∧ (∃ K : NNReal, LipschitzWith K F) ∧ (∀ w ∈ C, DifferentiableAt ℝ F w ∧ Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F w)) ∧ ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ F) C ∧ ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ v ∈ C, ∀ w ∈ C, c * ‖v - w‖ ≤ ‖F v - F w‖) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)).restrict a.M, ∀ w ∈ C, F w = x → ∀ f : C_c(Ambient n ℓ, ℝ), Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ (t ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ y, f (t⁻¹ • (y - x)) ∂(mk a).weight) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (a.θ x * ∫ y in (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ F w).toLinearMap : Set (Ambient n ℓ)), f y ∂μHE[n]))
